_comment_path: The interpreter path uses BACKSLASHES. cmd.exe parses a leading .venv/Scripts/... as the command `.venv` with a /Scripts switch, so the forward-slash form declared on 2026-08-15 exited in 0s with `'.venv' is not recognized` and the gate never ran once from the hook.
_comment_budget: The harness clamps timeoutSec to 170s. The unit suite is ~2276 tests in 460-560s on this 4 GB box, so it CANNOT be the hook gate: declaring it there gets the hook killed and produces no report at all, which is worse than a smaller gate. fast is therefore a smoke gate and says so; full is the definition of done and is run DETACHED (Start-Process -RedirectStandardOutput), never from the hook.
_comment_headroom: MEASURED 2026-08-15 through cmd.exe, the shell the hook uses: exit 0, 2289 collected in 100.45s, 119.8s wall, under load from a concurrent agent. 2289 = 2276 passed + 13 skipped, so collection covers the whole suite. HEADROOM IS ONLY ABOUT 50s. Most of it is import cost (docling pulls transformers and torch). If a future dependency pushes this past 170s the hook is killed and reports nothing at all, which looks identical to a gate that was never declared. Re-measure after adding any heavy dependency.
